sloka: दिष्ट्या न चलितः धर्मात् आत्मा ते सह लक्ष्मणः ।वत्स सत्य प्रतिज्ञो मे सताम् लोकान् अवाप्स्यसि ॥२-७५-६२॥
transliteration: diṣṭyā na calitaḥ dharmāt ātmā te saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ।vatsa satya pratijño me satām lokān avāpsyasi ॥2-75-62॥

translations.english: O dear child, fortunately your mind is unswerved from righteousness. You being truthful to your promise shall attain the world of virtuous men along with Lakshmana.
